apiErrors.recitation:
RECITATION_ERROR: Gemini detected content that may infringe copyright.

💡 This may be:
• Audio containing copyrighted music
• Content protected by copyright law
• Text excerpts from copyrighted books/documents

✨ Solutions:
• Try with a different audio clip without background music
• Remove the part of the audio with music before transcribing
• Use the "Manual Selection" feature to skip the problematic part

apiErrors.truncatedRefineWithSummary:
⚠️ Output truncated due to MAX_TOKENS limit.
• Summary: May be incomplete (last sentence cut off)
• Segments: Received {{count}} segments (may be missing)

💡 Solution: Split input data into smaller batches or increase maxOutputTokens in configuration.
apiErrors.truncatedRefine: ⚠️ Output may be truncated due to MAX_TOKENS limit. Received {{count}} segments. For more complete results, please split the file or use batch processing.
apiErrors.safetyFilter: Gemini Safety Filter blocked content: {{reason}}. Please check the audio file.
apiErrors.oom:
Device has insufficient memory to process audio file{{sizeHint}}.
💡 Solutions:
  • Use shorter files (< 10 min) or reduce recording quality
  • Close other tabs/applications to free up RAM
  • Try on a computer with more RAM
apiErrors.networkFailed:
Cannot connect to Gemini AI server (generativelanguage.googleapis.com).{{payloadNote}}
💡 Common causes and solutions:
  1. Firewall/Proxy blocking Google AI API → Try another network (4G/5G)
  2. ISP or VPN blocking googleapis.com → Disable VPN or change DNS (8.8.8.8)
  3. Internet connection lost during upload → Check wifi/ethernet
  4. Old TLS certificate (Windows/macOS not updated) → Update operating system
  5. Corporate network policy → Contact IT to whitelist generativelanguage.googleapis.com

🔍 Debug: Open DevTools (F12) → Network → check error details
apiErrors.networkPayloadNote: ⚠️ Large audio file (~{{size}} MB payload) – proxy/firewall may block this request
apiErrors.timeout:
Connection to Gemini AI timed out{{sizeHint}}.
💡 Solutions:
  • Audio file too large, slow network → try shorter files (< 10 min)
  • Check network speed at speedtest.net
  • Try again in a few minutes if Gemini server is overloaded
apiErrors.fileTooLarge:
File too large ({{size}}MB) - Exceeds browser processing capacity.

✨ Solutions:
1. If file is WAV/MP4/WebM: Convert to MP3 to reduce size (~70-90% smaller)
2. Split into smaller files (recommended < 500MB per file)
3. Use external tools to compress audio first

⚠️ Browser does not have enough memory to process this file.

help.title: 📚 LiveMeetingNotes App
help.introDesc: A web app to take meeting notes with the following capabilities:
help.feature1: 🎙️ Record audio and auto-timestamp when typing notes
help.feature2: 🗣️ Speech-to-text: Web Speech API (live, free) + Gemini AI (file, high quality)
help.feature3: 🤖 AI text refinement with Google Gemini (fix errors, remove fillers, punctuate)
help.feature4: ✏️ Edit/Delete individual transcription segments with double-click
help.feature5: ⏯️ Seek audio from timestamp in transcription
help.feature6: 🎬 Convert audio to text with Gemini AI (right-click waveform)
help.feature8: 💾 Save files directly to your computer
help.feature10: 🔒 100% secure - No data uploaded to server (unless using Gemini API)
help.feature12: 📂 Load Project - Reopen old project for editing
help.feature13: 📄 Export Word - Export .docx file for sharing
help.feature14: 🔔 Auto-update - Notification when new version is available
help.browserRecommend: Recommended: Chrome for the best experience.
help.authorName: Hi! I'm NguyenDacHung, the author of this app.
help.authorDesc: LiveMeetingNotes was developed to provide a free tool for professional, secure, and convenient meeting note-taking, storage, and management.
help.authorFree: The app is provided COMPLETELY FREE and is not for commercial purposes.
help.donateDesc: If you find LiveMeetingNotes helpful, you can make a voluntary donation directly to the Vietnam Children's Fund account.
help.donateNote: Transfer description: LiveMeetingNotes supports Vietnamese children
help.authorNote1: Donations are completely voluntary, not required, and do not affect any app features.
help.authorNote2: The author does not charge any usage fees in any form!
help.authorNote3: Any forced charging or impersonation of LiveMeetingNotes does not come from the author. Users are advised to be careful to avoid fraud.
